{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "noted wildcard onion binds bypass classification checks and suggested doc updates"
    },
    {
      "login": "winterrdog",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Approach ACK and Tested ACK on FreeBSD"
    },
    {
      "login": "vasild",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "ACK; suggested eliminating a redundant check, replied to sedited's concern, and proposed replacing -listenonion with -bind=...=onionauto"
    },
    {
      "login": "schildbach",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "noted container environments with dynamic IPs rely on wildcard binds and suggested solving via a second config option"
    },
    {
      "login": "jpk68",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "ACK"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "questioned the approach because common single-bind configurations will fail to start, suggesting a fallback to the default onion bind"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:5123605952",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Wildcard onion binds pass the new check but fail to tag incoming peers as onion, causing them to retain IP-network permissions such as noban",
      "quote": "-bind=0.0.0.0:8334=onion passes the new check while tagging nothing",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented a wildcard-bind check and test",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5300110647"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5300110647",
      "status_by_quote": "added a wildcard-bind check and test"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3942549044",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Explain in the -bind help and doc/tor.md when an explicit dedicated onion bind is required",
      "quote": "Would a line in one of the two be worth it?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added explanation to -bind help and doc/tor.md",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4090185376"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4090185376",
      "status_by_quote": "added this to both the `-bind` help and section 2 of `doc/tor.md`"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3942549046",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "Use assert_start_raises_init_error helper in the test to drop unused imports",
      "quote": "this could use the helper the file already uses further down",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author switched to the test helper",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4090191695"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4090191695",
      "status_by_quote": "Switched to `assert_start_raises_init_error`, thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4154988953",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Clarify the error message so it does not imply the requirement only applies when -bind is set",
      "quote": "With this PR the automatic Tor service requires a dedicated bind, always, unconditionally. Not only \"when -bind is set\".",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author shortened the error message",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4203420306"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4203420306",
      "status_by_quote": "Used your shorter version, thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4155241359",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Remove the duplicate check in AppInitParameterInteraction and keep only the check using connOptions.onion_binds",
      "quote": "Isn't this check redundant? Seems to be the same as the added check in `AppInitParameterInteraction()`. Better have just one.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author removed the duplicate check",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4203415489"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4203415489",
      "status_by_quote": "I agree that duplicating the argument parsing just for this case isn’t worth it - removed, thanks"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4155297810",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Correct the error message for wildcard onion binds because wildcard addresses still identify incoming Tor connections but Tor cannot forward to them",
      "quote": "This message is technically not correct. If wildcard address is used, incoming Tor connections will still be identified just fine.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "vasild accepted that wildcard onion binds fail to match and misclassify connections",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4203427683"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4312143482",
      "status_by_quote": "I got this wrong initially, thanks for correcting me."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4155644498",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Clarify in the release notes that any specific address can be used, not only 127.0.0.1",
      "quote": "The impression is that `127.0.0.1` must be used.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author clarified the release notes",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5438051959"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5438051959",
      "status_by_quote": "clarified the release notes"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6018333697",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Requiring a specific IP rather than wildcard binds conflicts with container environments where dynamic IPs are used",
      "quote": "when running in a container, it is considered best practise to bind to `0.0.0.0` / `[::]` rather than a specific IP.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author prefers to keep rejecting wildcard configurations in this PR and handle container support separately",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5438051959"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "r:5569390414"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:5438051959",
      "status_by_quote": "I'd keep rejecting these configurations in this PR and handle that support separately."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6633845084",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Existing deployments with a single bind will fail to start upon upgrade rather than falling back to the default onion listener",
      "quote": "So any existing deployment that has a single bind, which I think is a common configuration, will now fail to start? That seems harsh to me.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "vasild replied arguing the refuse-to-start behavior is harsh but acceptable and logical",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:6639171085"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6639171085",
      "status_by_quote": "I agree it is harsh. I think it is acceptable though."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6653671346",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Replace -listenonion with -bind=addr:port=onionauto to bundle automatic Tor service creation with a dedicated bind address",
      "quote": "what about replacing `-listenonion` with `-bind=addr:port=onionauto`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5123605952",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []

    {
      "id": "r:5138504878",

      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5378652791",
      "verdict": "Approach ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5569390414",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "adding another configuration option for containers would be overkill; docker can assign a specific IP",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6321045795",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "",

      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5605645895",
      "verdict": "Tested ACK",
      "reason": "successfully built & tested with `clang++-19` on FreeBSD `15.0`, targeting `x86_64`",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "vasild answered sedited's objection about single-bind setups failing to start, arguing the requirement is harsh but acceptable, and suggested redesigning the interface by replacing -listenonion with -bind=addr:port=onionauto.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "response to vasild's proposal to replace -listenonion with -bind=...=onionauto and sedited's concern about single-bind configs",
      "id": "c:6653671346"
    }
  ]
}
